[A]

Making love and I become
you Flesh is warm with naked feet

[A]me [F]
[G]Oh, [A]I'd beg for you,
[A]  [F]

[F]should die before me ask if
[G]you could bring a friend [Am]

[G]breath and drift away [Am]
